our_interpretation: This combines a release-policy change with a contemporaneous change in companies' token-use policies; it does not establish a causal motive.
In light of the following sentence about adding guardrails, Mythos includes a safeguarded Mythos-class version. It need not mean unrestricted access to the original April model.
No longer too dangerous means Anthropic considered the safeguarded version suitable for general release, not that every underlying capability was declared safe.
Tokenmaxxing ending means a broader management trend was giving way to spending discipline, not that every company stopped heavy AI use.
The qualitative budget-policy claim names no company financial measure; metric_scope is therefore null.

criteria.contradiction_condition: No safeguarded Mythos-class model was broadly released by June 9, or representative contemporaneous evidence establishes that the asserted spending-policy shift had not occurred.
